cbv29b:3.1: “There are, reverend Sir, some high ranking yakkhas who are not pleased with the Fortunate One,
cbv29b:3.2: there are, reverend Sir, some high ranking yakkhas who are pleased with the Fortunate One,
cbv29b:3.3: there are, reverend Sir, some middle ranking yakkhas who are not pleased with the Fortunate One,
cbv29b:3.4: there are, reverend Sir, some middle ranking yakkhas who are pleased with the Fortunate One,
cbv29b:3.5: there are, reverend Sir, some low ranking yakkhas who are not pleased with the Fortunate One,
cbv29b:3.6: there are, reverend Sir, some low ranking yakkhas who are pleased with the Fortunate One.
cbv29b:5.1: Because, reverend Sir, the Fortunate One preaches the Dhamma of refraining from killing living creatures,
cbv29b:5.2: preaches the Dhamma of refraining from taking what has not been given,
cbv29b:5.3: preaches the Dhamma of refraining from sexual misconduct,
cbv29b:5.4: preaches the Dhamma of refraining from false speech,
cbv29b:5.5: preaches the Dhamma of refraining from liquor, wines, or intoxicants which cause heedlessness.
cbv29b:5.6: But, reverend Sir, almost all of the yakkhas do not refrain from killing living creatures,
cbv29b:5.7: do not refrain from taking what has not been given,
cbv29b:5.8: do not refrain from sexual misconduct,
cbv29b:5.9: do not refrain from false speech,
cbv29b:5.10: do not refrain from liquors, wines, or intoxicants which cause heedlessness.
cbv29b:17.1: Whoever, dear Sir - be they monk or nun
cbv29b:17.2: or layman or laywoman - learns this “Āṭānāṭiya” protection well,
cbv29b:17.3: and will master it in its entirety, then if a non-human being -
cbv29b:17.4: be they male yakkha or female yakkha or yakkha boy
cbv29b:17.5: or yakkha girl or yakkha minister
cbv29b:17.6: or yakkha councillor or yakkha messenger
cbv29b:17.7: or male gandhabba or female gandhabba or gandhabba boy
cbv29b:17.8: or gandhabba girl or gandhabba minister
cbv29b:17.9: or gandhabba councillor or gandhabba messenger
cbv29b:17.10: or male kumbhaṇḍa or female kumbhaṇḍa or kumbhaṇḍa boy
cbv29b:17.11: or kumbhaṇḍa girl or kumbhaṇḍa minister
cbv29b:17.12: or kumbhaṇḍa councillor or kumbhaṇḍa messenger
cbv29b:17.13: or male nāga or female nāga or nāga boy
cbv29b:17.14: or nāga girl or nāga minister
cbv29b:17.15: or nāga councillor or nāga messenger -
cbv29b:17.16: with a wicked mind should come near while they are going, or stand near while they are standing,
cbv29b:17.17: or sit near while they are sitting, or lie near while they are lying,
cbv29b:19.1: Now, dear Sir, whatever non-human beings -
cbv29b:19.2: be they male yakkha or female yakkha or yakkha boy
cbv29b:19.3: or yakkha girl or yakkha minister
cbv29b:19.4: or yakkha councillor or yakkha messenger
cbv29b:19.5: or male gandhabba or female gandhabba or gandhabba boy
cbv29b:19.6: or gandhabba girl or gandhabba minister
cbv29b:19.7: or gandhabba councillor or gandhabba messenger
cbv29b:19.8: or male kumbhaṇḍa or female kumbhaṇḍa or kumbhaṇḍa boy
cbv29b:19.9: or kumbhaṇḍa girl or kumbhaṇḍa minister
cbv29b:19.10: or kumbhaṇḍa councillor or kumbhaṇḍa messenger
cbv29b:19.11: or male nāga or female nāga or nāga boy
cbv29b:19.12: or nāga girl or nāga minister
cbv29b:19.13: or nāga councillor or nāga messenger -
cbv29b:19.14: with a wicked mind should come near a monk or a nun or a layman or a laywoman
cbv29b:19.15: while they are going, or stand near while they are standing,
cbv29b:19.16: or sit near while they are sitting, or lie near while they are lying,
cbv29b:22.1: By this declaration of the truth may you be safe at all times!
cbv29b:22.2: By this declaration of the truth may you have the blessing of success!
cbv29b:22.3: By this declaration of the truth may all disease be destroyed!
cbv29b:24.1: The Text of the Four Recitals is Finished
